gate_1_performance.notes: SR 0.800 below 1.0 target. CAGR 11.91% below 16% target. MDD 33.19% exceeds 25% limit. DD_tight (10/25) did NOT improve MDD vs base (34.31%) — only marginal 1.1pp reduction while sacrificing 1.5pp CAGR. Variant is strictly dominated by base on return/risk.

gate_3_role_honesty.notes: BM correlation 0.62 is moderate — consistent with diversifier role. Value factor has regime-dependent behavior (GFC +27.23% alpha, COVID -7.71%). Role declaration honest.

gate_4_statistical.notes: FF3/FF5 alphas positive but statistically insignificant (all t < 2.0, except FF5a t=1.42). FMB Score lambda t=2.05 is significant — cross-sectional pricing power exists. IC decaying (ratio 0.52). OOS retention 0.47 is borderline. No Harvey t>3.0 threshold met.

gate_5_ff5_diversification.notes: Stress resilience decent (2/3). Rolling consistency acceptable. COVID underperformance is value-factor structural weakness.

variant_comparison.assessment: DD_tight trades 1.5pp CAGR and 0.06 SR for only 1.1pp MDD improvement. Poor trade-off. Tighter DD (10/25) activates too early, cutting upside without meaningful downside protection. Base is superior.

summary: STR_1333_A1_DD_tight is PIT-clean (Gate 0 PASS) but underperforms the base variant on all return metrics while achieving only marginal MDD reduction. Grade B, Score 32.3. The DD_tight overlay (10/25 vs base 15/35) triggers too aggressively, reducing equity exposure during mild drawdowns and destroying alpha. FF5 alpha exists but is statistically insignificant (t=1.42). IC decay (ratio 0.52) signals weakening factor predictiveness. Keep as reference for DD parameter sensitivity analysis, but do not promote.
